title: Kalai's 3^d Conjecture
exact_target: Must every centrally symmetric d-dimensional convex polytope have at least 3 to the d nonempty faces, counting the whole polytope?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1381 (GEOM-022). CC BY 4.0.
Raman Sanyal, Axel Werner and Günter M. Ziegler, \emph{On Kalai's conjectures concerning centrally symmetric polytopes} (2007), arXiv:0708.3661v2, Section 1, Conjecture A.
